question: At the measured 0.780757973 seconds/request H100 endpoint rate, can one H100 plus bounded retail overflow still beat the current retail tiers while keeping background wait usable?
why_now: The previous overflow frontier used the faster 171-request discriminator and explicitly nominated the pending 791-request endpoint service time as decisive. That endpoint is now terminal, materially slower, and scope-matched scheduling economics must be recomputed without touching the H100.

analysis_contract.controls: Reproduce the prior 0.707333994-second replay exactly before substituting the measured 0.780757973-second endpoint rate.
analysis_contract.observed_prefix: Replay requests 0 through 790 using their exact arrivals and tokens. Report finite drain, peak wait, p50/p95/p99 wait, spill count, spill tokens, H100 busy time, and total blended cost.
analysis_contract.periodic_prefix: Repeat the exact 791-request prefix periodically with a clearly stated period derived from its bound arrivals. Separate finite drain from sustainable periodic behavior.
analysis_contract.full_trace_extrapolation: Replay all 1,036 requests at the measured endpoint service rate, labeled analytical extrapolation beyond the measured 791-request prefix.
analysis_contract.pareto: For wait caps from zero retail-only through no-spill H100-only, compute the minimum feasible spill policy and cost-versus-wait Pareto frontier for all three frozen retail tiers. Include one-second and five-second caps.
analysis_contract.fleet_comparators: Keep continuous 90%-utilization H100 economics, discrete two-H100 economics, one-H100-plus-overflow, and retail-only economics separate.
analysis_contract.quality_label: Every self-hosted or hybrid result is deployment-ineligible until the endpoint semantic divergence is localized or repaired. Do not convert scheduling economics into a production recommendation.
analysis_contract.outputs: Persist ENDPOINT_OVERFLOW_RESULT_20260725.json and ENDPOINT_OVERFLOW_DECISION_20260725.md without overwriting prior artifacts.

budgets.local_compute: At most 10 CPU-minutes and 1 GiB RAM; no CUDA.

prohibitions: Do not create, claim, inspect, SSH to, or mutate any provider resource or GPU bench.
Do not read, poll, signal, or modify the active packed-mask H100 project.
Do not replay either consumed endpoint sample or issue an inference request.
Do not refresh market prices or GPU prices.
Do not overwrite BACKGROUND_OVERFLOW_RESULT.json or its replay script.
Do not treat the measured 791-request service rate as measured evidence for requests 791 through 1035.
Do not claim production eligibility while normalized endpoint semantics are divergent.
